reviewNotes: HOLD — UDSN is a public university listed by the ministry. Its official accessible admissions material concerns applied-science bachelor entry, not medicine; it states a CEMAC/non-CEMAC dossier charge but not medical tuition. WHO documentation of a health-related equipment donation does not establish a medical degree. No current medical programme was verified, so this is not a safe medical-university candidate for publication.
